==Notes==
* This skill is granted to players by [[Courier Falken]] during the quest [[Cantha Courier Crisis]].
* When activated, a speech balloon appears above the character saying, "<character name>..." When Falken's Fire Fist completes its activation, "PUNCH!" appears.
* Requires either [[Brass Knuckles]] or [[Thunderfist's Brass Knuckles]].

==Trivia==
*This is a reference to ''Falcon Punch'', a trademark attack of [[wikipedia:Captain Falcon|Captain Falcon]], who is found in both the anime [[wikipedia:F-Zero: GP Legend (anime)|F-Zero: GP Legend]] and the [[wikipedia:F-Zero|F-Zero]] video game series.  This refers directly to the Super Smash Bros. series, in which Captain Falcon is a playable character and Falcon Punch is one of his special attacks with a fiery animation.
